content: उत्कलापयति <ab>Den.</ab> <ab>P.</ab> .²1 To ask (one) permission to go, take leave of; <ls>Pt. 5</ls>. .²2 To cause the peacock to spread its plumage. .²3 To cause (one) to be proud, produce conceit by an acknowledgment of merit. .²4 To bring oneʼs wife home from her fatherʼs house; to marry; <ab>Ved.</ab>
